PreToolUse.message: Before creating: check if a similar file already exists via file_search. Never duplicate files. Check applyTo-matched instructions for conventions.
Before editing: read the file first. Include 3+ lines of context. Use multi_replace for 2+ independent edits. Never use oldString from summarized/compacted docs.

Prefer run_task for workspace tasks (Vitest, Playwright, lint, build, coverage). Prefer get_errors for single-file diagnostics (ESLint+Stylelint+webhint+markdownlint+spell). PowerShell only — never bash/Unix. Use ; not && to chain.
Before renaming: call vscode_listCodeUsages first to verify all references. Check that the new name follows project naming conventions (_camelCase for private, cGet/cSet for cache, setSync for sync).
Never call semantic_search in parallel with other semantic_search calls. Use grep_search with alternation (word1|word2) for exact matches instead. Use search_subagent for multi-file exploration.

Subagents are stateless — pass ALL context in one prompt. Specify exact return shape. For read-only exploration use 'Explore' agent. For data flow use 'api-integrator'. For UI use 'dashboard-designer'. For quality gates use 'quality-reviewer'.

PostToolUse.message: Post-edit checklist: RTL logical props · CSS custom properties only · cGet→null not undefined · textContent not innerHTML · dialog+showModal for overlays · correct @layer · card data-card-id=registry-id. Run get_errors on changed files to catch ESLint+Stylelint+webhint+spell issues.
Post-terminal: if command was a test/lint/build, check exit code. If errors found, fix before proceeding. Coverage Gutters and Error Lens show results inline — point user to them.
